runs.summary: First full health check of the data. It found contacts recorded while the phones were closed, and a check that was raising false alarms about agent activity.

runs.notes: Run 2: after remediation R01 (pre-opening contacts) and rule refinements (VAL-005, VAL-023, VOL-013)
runs.summary: Removed 6,039 contacts recorded before opening time and fixed the cause. Two checks were made more precise; the sharper opening-hours check then found 8 contacts recorded just after closing.

runs.notes: Run 3: after source fix and remediation for after-closing contacts (VAL-005)
runs.summary: Removed the 8 contacts recorded just after closing and fixed the cause, so contacts can no longer be recorded while the phones are closed.

runs.notes: Run 4: new profile-driven rules (CMP-018, VAL-024, VAL-025) after profiling exposed constant/empty customer_product columns
runs.summary: Added three new checks after spotting a customer product field that was never filled in. They correctly flagged an error in how customer product records had been generated.

runs.notes: Run 5: customer products regenerated with fixed random draws (07b); VAL-025 made relative to time since launch
runs.summary: Rebuilt the customer product records to fix that error: products now open on realistic dates, and some close or go dormant. All three new checks now pass.
